document_id.description: ACRIS document id: 16 digits (`2013100700087001`), `FT_` + 13 digits, or the ACRIS DocumentDetail URL carrying `doc_id=`.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One recorded ACRIS document by its 16-character document id (or an a836-acris.nyc.gov DocumentDetail URL), assembled from four NYC Open Data SODA datasets: Real Property Master (bnx9-e6tj) for CRFN, type, dates and amount; Real Property Parties (636b-3b5g) for grantor/grantee/mortgagor names and addresses; Real Property Legals (8h5j-fqxa) for the lots it is recorded against; Document Control Codes (7isb-wh4c) to decode the type into a description, class and the meaning of each party slot. An id the Master dataset does not have is `not_found` (the open-data extract lags the live register; the `acris_url` page may already exist); a malformed id is `invalid_input`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acris_url` | string | Legacy ACRIS detail page: https://a836-acris.nyc.gov/DS/DocumentSearch/DocumentDetail?doc_id=<document_id> |
| `crfn` | string | 13-digit City Register File Number. |
| `doc_class` | string | Document class, e.g. DEEDS AND OTHER CONVEYANCES, MORTGAGES & INSTRUMENTS. |
| `doc_type` | string | ACRIS document type code. |
| `doc_type_description` | string | From Document Control Codes, e.g. DEED. |
| `document_amount_usd` | number |  |
| `document_date` | string |  |
| `document_id` | string |  |
| `good_through_date` | string |  |
| `modified_date` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix time in milliseconds when the program observed the source. |
| `parcel_count` | number |  |
| `parcels` | object[] | Every lot the document is recorded against. |
| `parties` | object[] | All parties, in party_type order. |
| `party_count` | number |  |
| `percent_transferred` | number |  |
| `recorded_borough` | number |  |
| `recorded_datetime` | string |  |
| `reel_number` | number |  |

post.description:
Sales and deed history, mortgages and other recorded instruments for a parcel by BBL. Follow with `acris_document` for parties (grantor/grantee) and the decoded document type.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

bbl.description: Borough-Block-Lot: the 10-digit form `1008350041` (borough 1-5, 5-digit block, 4-digit lot) or `1-835-41` / `1/835/41`.

cursor.description: Row offset to resume from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

doc_type.description: ACRIS document type code to keep, e.g. `DEED`, `MTGE`, `AGMT`, `SAT`, `UCC1`. Case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9 ,&/._-]+$.

limit.description:
Legals rows per page (1-100, default 25).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Recorded ACRIS real-property documents (deeds, mortgages, agreements, liens, ...) against one tax lot, from NYC Open Data: ACRIS Real Property Legals (8h5j-fqxa) filtered by borough/block/lot gives the document ids, then ACRIS Real Property Master (bnx9-e6tj) supplies type, dates, CRFN and amount for that page in one `$where=document_id in(...)` call. Ordered newest first (document ids are date-prefixed; pre-1966 `FT_` microfilm ids sort last). Optional `doc_type` keeps only that ACRIS code (e.g. DEED) within each page; the page still advances through all the lot's documents, so a filtered page may hold fewer than `limit` documents while `next_cursor` is set. Paged with `limit` / `cursor` (row offset into Legals). A lot with no recorded documents but present in PLUTO is a successful empty page; a BBL that neither ACRIS nor PLUTO knows is `not_found`. The open-data extract lags the live City Register by weeks (Master last updated 2026-09-08 at capture); `acris_url` links each document to the authoritative page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `documents` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acris_url` | string | Legacy ACRIS detail page: https://a836-acris.nyc.gov/DS/DocumentSearch/DocumentDetail?doc_id=<document_id> |
| `crfn` | string | 13-digit City Register File Number; null when the Master row is not (yet) in the open-data extract. |
| `doc_type` | string | ACRIS document type code (DEED, MTGE, AGMT, ...). Decode with `acris_document`. |
| `document_amount_usd` | number | Consideration / mortgage amount; 0 when none. |
| `document_date` | string | ISO date on the instrument. |
| `document_id` | string | 16-character ACRIS document id (`2013100700087001`, or `FT_...` for pre-1966 microfilm documents). |
| `master_found` | boolean | False when ACRIS Real Property Master has no row for this id (extract lag); the doc fields are then null. |
| `parcels` | object[] | The lots this document is recorded against (one row per lot in ACRIS Legals; only the searched lot when it is filtered). |
| `percent_transferred` | number |  |
| `recorded_borough` | number |  |
| `recorded_datetime` | string | ISO date the City Register recorded it. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Construction, alteration, plumbing or demolition permit history for a building once you have its BIN (from `resolve_address`).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

bin.description: 7-digit DOB Building Identification Number, e.g. `1015862` (first digit is the borough 1-5). Get it from `resolve_address`. Pattern: ^[1-5][0-9]{6}$.

cursor.description: Row offset to resume from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

limit.description:
Permits per page (1-100, default 25).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Permits issued by the Department of Buildings for one building (BIN), from NYC Open Data DOB Permit Issuance (SODA dataset ipu4-2q9a, the BIS system: every construction, plumbing, equipment and demolition permit since 1989, updated daily). Ordered newest job first (`job__ DESC, permit_sequence__ DESC`: job numbers are 9-digit and increase over time; renewals of one job follow the initial permit). Each row is shaped (job number, types, status, ISO dates, permittee and owner business names) and carried whole in `fields`. Paged with `limit` / `cursor`. An empty first page triggers a cross-check of the DOB Violations and ECB Violations datasets for the same BIN: no row anywhere is `not_found` (unknown BIN); a known building with no permits is a successful empty page. DOB NOW filings (post-2020 work filed outside BIS) are not in this dataset.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `permits` as the primary payload key.

post.description:
Open or resolved DOB violations, ECB/OATH summonses and outstanding penalties for a building by BIN.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.

bin.description: 7-digit DOB Building Identification Number, e.g. `1015862` (first digit is the borough 1-5). Get it from `resolve_address`. Pattern: ^[1-5][0-9]{6}$.

cursor.description: Row offset to resume from: the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

kind.description:
dob: DOB Violations (3h2n-5cm9); ecb: ECB/OATH violations (6bgk-3dad).

Provider reference: allowed values ["dob", "ecb"]; default "dob".

limit.description:
Violations per page (1-100, default 25).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Violations against one building (BIN) from NYC Open Data: `kind: dob` reads DOB Violations (SODA 3h2n-5cm9; violations issued by DOB inspectors, with disposition) and `kind: ecb` reads DOB ECB Violations (6bgk-3dad; Environmental Control Board / OATH summonses with hearing status, severity, penalties, amounts paid and balance due). Ordered by `issue_date DESC`. Rows are shaped into one common record (`kind` says which fields apply) and carried whole in `fields`. Paged with `limit` / `cursor`. An empty first page triggers a cross-check of the sibling DOB datasets (permits and the other violation kind) for the same BIN: no row anywhere is `not_found`; a known building with no violations of that kind is a successful empty page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `violations` as the primary payload key.

| `balance_due_usd` | number | ecb only. |
| `block` | string |  |
| `category_or_status` | string | dob: `violation_category` (V-DOB VIOLATION - ACTIVE / V*-DOB VIOLATION - Resolved); ecb: `ecb_violation_status` (ACTIVE / RESOLVE). |
| `certification_status` | string | ecb only. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `device_number` | string | dob only: elevator/boiler device. |
| `disposition_comments` | string | dob only. |

| `fields` | object | The complete source row exactly as SODA returns it. |

| `house_number` | string |  |

Owner of record, lot and building facts, assessed value or zoning for a parcel once you have its BBL (from `resolve_address`).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

200.description:
The MapPLUTO tax-lot record for one BBL from NYC Open Data (SODA dataset 64uk-42ks, Department of City Planning): owner of record (`owner_name`, `owner_type`), address, building class, land use, year built and altered, floors, units, lot and building areas (sq ft), Department of Finance assessed land/total values (USD), zoning districts, landmark status, community and council districts, coordinates and the PLUTO release version. `pluto` carries the complete row exactly as published (all ~90 columns, strings). An unknown or retired BBL (SODA answers `[]`) is `not_found`; a malformed BBL is `invalid_input`. Links: `acris_url` opens the ACRIS document search pre-scoped to the lot.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Resolve a free-text NYC address to its Borough-Block-Lot (BBL) and Building Identification Number (BIN) with the Department of City Planning's GeoSearch API (https://geosearch.planninglabs.nyc/v2/search, a Pelias geocoder over the Property Address Directory). Returns up to `limit` candidate matches ordered by GeoSearch relevance, each with the normalized address, borough, ZIP, coordinates and the PAD `bbl` / `bin` that key every other function of this program. Zero matches is a successful empty result (`count: 0`), not an error. Anonymous, no token.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `matches` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accuracy` | string | point or centroid. |
| `bbl` | string | 10-digit Borough-Block-Lot from PAD (`addendum.pad.bbl`); the key for `property` and `acris_documents`. Null when the match carries no PAD record. |
| `bin` | string | 7-digit Building Identification Number from PAD (`addendum.pad.bin`); the key for `dob_permits` and `dob_violations`. |
| `borough` | string | Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens or Staten Island. |
| `confidence` | number | Pelias confidence 0-1. |
| `gid` | string | Pelias global id (`nycpad:venue:88717`). |
| `house_number` | string |  |
| `label` | string | Full label as GeoSearch renders it, e.g. `350 5 AVENUE, New York, NY, USA`. |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `layer` | string | Pelias layer: address, venue, street, ... |
| `locality` | string |  |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `match_type` | string | Pelias match type: exact, interpolated, fallback, ... |
| `name` | string | Normalized address line (`350 5 AVENUE`). |
| `neighbourhood` | string |  |
| `pad_version` | string | Property Address Directory release the BBL/BIN come from (`26c`). |
| `postal_code` | string |  |
| `street` | string | Street name in the city's normalized form (`5 AVENUE`). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
